[P1] 童读·中华经典神话故事
鲲鹏之变
毛红艳/改编，先知先觉/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P2] 中华经典神话故事绘本
鲲鹏之变
毛红艳/改编 先知先桃/绘
新疆人民出版社
新疆科学技术出版社

[P3] “啵！”
在一根随着水波飘摇的海草上，一条小鱼从卵里钻了出来。
看到小鱼，小鹦鹉螺觉得有点饿了。
它悄悄地游过去。

[P4] “不，你不能吃我！”
“为什么呢？”
“我这么小，吃了也不顶饱呀！不如
留着，等我明天长大一点再吃。”
“明天你就能长大吗？”
“能呀，明天我会让你大吃一惊的！”

[P5] 第二天，一条大鱼来找小鹦鹉螺。
“嗨，今天你可以吃我了！”，
“你就是昨天的小鱼？”小鹦鹉螺瞪圆了眼睛，“这么大，我可吞不下去！”，
大鱼哈哈大笑：“我叫鲲，将来会长成北海最大的鱼哦！来，到我的背上来！”，

[P6] 鲲和小鹦鹉螺潜到最
深的海沟，被有十个身体
的何罗鱼吓了一跳。

[P7] 鲲和小鹦鹉螺游到北海之北，看到了万年不化的冰山，冻得瑟瑟发抖。

[P8] 鲲和小鹦鹉螺浮上海面，迎着皎洁的
月光，被海浪抛向天空，好像飞了起来。
“飞上天！飞上天！”
鲲用力拍打着鳍，想再飞高一点，亲
一亲那轮圆圆的月亮。

[P9] 可是，“砰——”鲲重重地摔回了海里。
现在，他已经是北海最大的鱼了，他的
身体，有几千里长，落在海里，激起的巨浪，
像一座座直插云霄的山峰。
小鹦鹉螺紧紧地吸在鲲的背上，生怕一
不小心就被巨浪打下去。

[P10] 不知过了多久，海水才平静下来。鲲和小鹦鹉螺漂浮在海面上。望着圆圆的月亮，鲲问小鹦鹉螺：“怎样才能飞上天呢？”
小鹦鹉螺从来没有离开过大海，更没有飞上过蓝天，他当然不知道答案。但是，他有办法：“我们去问问那些会飞的鸟吧！”

[P11] 在北海边的悬崖上有一棵树，树上住着一只斑鸠，还有一只总是“知了知了”乱叫的蝉。
鲲和小鹦鹉螺来到树下，大声问道：“斑鸠，你知道怎样飞上九万里高的天空吗？”

[P12] “首先，你得有对翅膀。”蝉展开自己薄而透明的翅膀，抢着说。
“除了翅膀，你还得有像我这样美丽的羽毛，轻巧的身体。”斑鸠抖了抖身上的羽毛说，“我天生会飞，却也只能飞几丈高，飞一阵儿还得停在树上休息一会儿。你这样的鱼，偶尔跳出海面玩一玩就行了，飞九万里那么高干什么！”

[P13] 从这一天开始，鲲每天练习用鳍拍打水面，让自己从海中跳起来。
第一天，刚离开海面，他就立刻落回了海里。
第二天，他能跳得高一点点了。
第三天……
第四天……

[P14] 终于有一天，当鲲用力击打
水面后，他的身体弹了起来。
向上！
向上！
超过了悬崖边的树！
超过了悬崖！
超过了缓飞的小鸟！
穿过了云层！
超过了展翅的雄鹰！

[P15] 鲲身上的鳞片，变成了轻盈的羽毛；他的鳍，长成了有力的翅膀；他的背，像泰山一样宽厚。他变成了一只鸟，一只叫做“鹏”的巨大的鸟。

[P16] 鹏用力挥动翅膀，风轻轻托着他，扶摇直上，天空仿佛被他背了起来，越升越高。
他从九万里的高空向下看，连绵不断的群山，只剩下一点绿色，浩瀚的北海，只是一个
小水洼，天地之间，好像只有自己和小鹦鹉螺。

[P17] “天空有多大，它有尽头吗？”
鹏带着小鹦鹉螺，向南飞去。
full_text_en:
[P1] Children's Reading · Chinese Classic Mythological Stories
The Transformation of Kun and Peng
Adapted by Mao Hongyan, Illustrated by Xianzhi Xianjue
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P2] Chinese Classic Mythology Picture Book
The Transformation of Kun and Peng
Adapted by Mao Hongyan, Illustrated by Xianzhi Xian Tao
Xinjiang People's Publishing House
Xinjiang Science and Technology Press

[P3] "Plop!"
On a strand of seaweed swaying with the waves, a little fish emerged from its egg.
Seeing the little fish, the young nautilus felt a bit hungry.
It quietly swam over.

[P4] "No, you can't eat me!"
"Why not?"
"I'm so small, eating me won't even fill you up! Why not
leave me here and wait until I grow a bit bigger tomorrow."
"Will you really grow bigger tomorrow?"
"Of course! Tomorrow I'll surprise you!"

[P5] The next day, a big fish came to find the little nautilus.
"Hey, you can eat me today!"
"You're the little fish from yesterday?" the little nautilus widened its eyes, "You're so big, I can't swallow you!"
The big fish laughed heartily: "My name is Kun. I'll grow up to be the biggest fish in the Northern Sea! Come, get on my back!"

[P6] Kun and the little nautilus dived to the deepest trench, and were startled by the He Luo fish with ten bodies.

[P7] Kun and the little nautilus swam to the north of the Northern Sea, where they saw an ice mountain that had never melted for ten thousand years, and shivered with cold.

[P8] Kun and the little nautilus floated to the surface, facing the bright moonlight, tossed by the waves into the sky, as if flying.
"Fly up! Fly up!"
Kun flapped its fins hard, wanting to fly even higher, to kiss
the round, round moon.

[P9] But with a 'thud——', Kun fell heavily back into the sea.
Now, he was the biggest fish in the Northern Sea. His body, thousands of li long, plunged into the sea, stirring up huge waves that looked like mountain peaks piercing the clouds.
The little nautilus clung tightly to Kun's back, afraid that it might be knocked off by the giant waves at any moment.

[P10] After a while, the sea calmed down. Kun and the little nautilus floated on the surface. Looking at the round moon, Kun asked the little nautilus, "How can we fly up to the sky?"
The little nautilus had never left the sea, nor had he ever flown into the blue sky. Of course, he didn't know the answer. But he had an idea: "Let's ask those birds that can fly!"

[P11] On a cliff by the North Sea, there is a tree. A spotted dove lives in it, along with a cicada that always chirps 'zhī le zhī le'.
Kun and the little nautilus arrive beneath the tree and shout, 'Dove, do you know how to fly up to the sky nine万里 high?'

[P12] "First, you need a pair of wings," the cicada said, spreading its thin and transparent wings eagerly.
"Besides wings, you also need beautiful feathers and a light body like mine," the spotted dove said, fluffing its feathers. "I was born to fly, but I can only fly a few zhang high, and after a while, I have to rest on a tree. You, a fish like you, should just jump out of the sea to play occasionally—why fly as high as ninety thousand li!"

[P13] From this day on, Kun practiced using his fins to slap the water, trying to jump out of the sea.
On the first day, as soon as he left the surface, he immediately fell back into the sea.
On the second day, he could jump a little higher.
On the third day……
On the fourth day……

[P14] Finally, one day, when Kun struck the water with force,
his body leapt up.
Up!
Up!
Beyond the trees by the cliff!
Beyond the cliff!
Beyond the slowly flying birds!
Through the cloud layers!
Beyond the soaring eagles!

[P15] The scales on Kun's body turned into light feathers; his fins grew into powerful wings; his back became as broad as Mount Tai. He became a bird, a huge bird called 'Peng'.

[P16] The Peng flapped its wings with great force, and the wind gently carried it upward, soaring higher and higher, as if the sky itself were being lifted by it.
From a height of ninety thousand li, he looked down: the endless mountain ranges were reduced to mere specks of green, the vast Northern Sea was just a small puddle, and between heaven and earth, it seemed there was only himself and the little nautilus.

[P17] "How vast is the sky, and does it have an end?"
The Peng, carrying the little nautilus, flies southward.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《鲲鹏之变》的封面，展示了在月夜海浪中跃起的鲲鱼形象，上方有书名、改编者和绘者信息，以及出版社名称。
[P2] 本页为绘本《鲲鹏之变》的封面，展示了书名、改编者、绘者及出版社信息，中央绘有一条跃动的鲲鱼形象。
[P3] 在海底的海草间，一条小鱼从卵中孵化出来，小鹦鹉螺看到后觉得饿了，悄悄游了过去。
[P4] 小鱼刚孵化出来，小鹦鹉螺想吃它，小鱼请求等它长大再吃，并承诺明天会让人惊讶。
[P5] 第二天，一条名叫鲲的大鱼来找小鹦鹉螺，声称自己已长大，邀请小鹦鹉螺骑到它背上，但小鹦鹉螺因它太大而无法吞食。
[P6] 鲲和小鹦鹉螺潜入深海海沟，被一条拥有十个身体的何罗鱼吓了一跳。
[P7] 鲲和小鹦鹉螺游到北海之北，看到万年不化的冰山，冻得瑟瑟发抖。
[P8] 鲲和小鹦鹉螺浮上海面，在月光下被海浪抛向天空，鲲兴奋地想飞得更高，亲吻月亮。
[P9] 鲲从空中摔回海里，激起巨大浪花，小鹦鹉螺紧紧吸附在鲲背上，害怕被巨浪打落。
[P10] 鲲和小鹦鹉螺在月夜下漂浮于海面，鲲询问如何飞上天，小鹦鹉螺提议去请教会飞的鸟。
[P11] 鲲和小鹦鹉螺来到北海边的悬崖下，向树上的斑鸠请教如何飞上九万里高的天空。
[P12] 鲲向斑鸠请教如何飞上九万里高空，蝉抢先建议要有翅膀，斑鸠则认为鲲作为鱼无需飞那么高，只适合偶尔跃出海面玩耍。
[P13] 鲲开始每天练习用鳍拍打水面跳离海面，第一天失败，第二天跳得稍高，第三、四天仍在持续练习。
[P14] 鲲终于成功跃出水面，奋力向上跳跃，接连超越了悬崖、树木、飞鸟和云层，展现出飞向天空的壮丽景象。
[P15] 鲲的身体发生蜕变，鳞片化为羽毛，鳍长成翅膀，背如泰山般宽厚，最终变成一只名为“鹏”的巨大飞鸟。
[P16] 鲲已化身为鹏，奋力振翅高飞，扶摇直上九万里高空，俯瞰大地如微缩景观，天地间仿佛只有它与小鹦鹉螺相伴。
[P17] 鲲已化身为鹏，在星空下振翅高飞，带着小鹦鹉螺向南飞行，并思考天空的边界。
[P18] 画面中，鲲在月夜下的海面上奋力跃出水面，身体部分已显现出羽毛和翅膀的特征，周围浪花飞溅，展现出其向天空蜕变的瞬间。
